summary_markdown: The conversation focused on modifying a complex data request for passenger tracking (originally related to Hong Kong flights). The initial criteria required the passenger to be 'first seen' at immigration and 'last seen' at the gate two hours before departure. The key change agreed upon was updating the second criterion: instead of requiring the passenger to be 'first seen' at immigration, the requirement is now simply that the passenger must have been 'seen' at a duty-free facility sometime before their last recorded session at the gate.
decisions: The tracking query structure and flight linkage remain unchanged.
action_items: Update the second condition of the passenger tracking query to check for 'seen' status at a duty-free facility before the last recorded session at the gate, replacing the previous 'first seen' requirement at immigration.
